rationale: The agent did look up the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details) and accessed an order, but it executed order-changing writes (return_delivered_order_items and exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming with the user, which violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the user asked to know the money saved in both ways and to prefer the greater savings if only one action were possible; the agent only calculated savings for the exchanges and did not present or compare savings for returning the water bottle. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy and key informational requirements were missing.
